basic_info.description: Two VACANT units in a prime location directly across from the University of San Francisco, perfect for owner-occupiers or investors. This charming corner building is bathed in natural light, offering a bright and welcoming atmosphere.  Each turnkey unit boasts spacious living room, formal dining room, kitchen with peek-a-boo view of the bay, two generously sized bedrooms, and a full bathroom. The ground floor includes two private one-car garages, a laundry room, and additional storage. Residents may also enjoy eligibility for membership at the Koret Health and Recreation Center and easy access to Golden Gate Park and public transportation. Don't miss this exceptional opportunity!  2336-2338 Golden Gate Avenue, the adjacent building, is also being offered for sale.
